forward_demo_rules.account_scope: A1 only unless owner separately authorizes a clean-control account.
forward_demo_rules.kill_rule: Stop or revert if rolling 80-trade PF < 0.95, drawdown exceeds 1.5x historical package DD scaled to lot/account, net negative after 150 trades, or any broker/runtime safety violation appears.
forward_demo_rules.minimum_forward_sample: At least 4 weeks and at least 150 closed trades before any promotion decision; prefer 8 weeks / 300 trades.
forward_demo_rules.no_tuning_rule: Do not change hours, filters, RR, package target, cooldown, lot, or magics during the forward window.
forward_demo_rules.package_guard: +75 USD target, no shared max-trade cap, 10-minute cooldown after any package loss.
forward_demo_rules.pass_rule: Forward PF >= 1.25, WR >= 55%, net positive, trades/active day >= 3, trades/market day >= 2 where market is open, positive active days >= 55%, and no single day contributes more than 30% of net.

v9_v10_rr2_stretch.interpretation: Payoff >=2.0 is possible, but the current entry families collapse below 50% win rate at that payoff.

opening_range_reversal_step4.interpretation: The family improves activity and preserves roughly 2R realized payoff, but WR remains around 32-33%, far below the 50% owner target.

rr2_profit_lock_management_probe.interpretation: Profit-lock recovers WR above 50%, but realized W/L collapses far below the owner target of 2.0.

external_macro_traffic_light_gate.interpretation: External daily macro gates did not bridge the WR/W-L tradeoff. High-WR rows remained low W/L, while 2R rows remained low WR.

split_break_distance_guard_exact_probe.interpretation: The strongest internal near miss did not survive exact component-level MT5 implementation. It kept WR above 50% but W/L fell to 1.4857.

early_adverse_exit_exact_probe.interpretation: MT5-side early loss truncation can lift realized W/L above 2.0, but it converts too many potential recoveries into losses. No cell reaches WR >= 50% and W/L >= 2.0 together.

early_adverse_internal_gate_diagnostic.interpretation: Causal feature gates on the exact early-adverse population did not produce a valid in-sample core hit with the sample/activity floor. Do not spend reviewer token.

v7_v8_v11_v13_rr2_stretch_probe.interpretation: Fresh EMA pullback, compression, and EMA-trend families repeat the high-payoff/low-WR corner when stretched to 2R. No row reaches WR >= 50% and W/L >= 2.0.

step3_portfolio_composition.method: Offline portfolio composition over exact MT5 Strategy Tester trade CSVs and exact MT5 signal ledgers only; no MT5 launch, no runtime attach, no inferred exits.
step3_portfolio_composition.interpretation: Portfolio composition improved activity but did not bridge the owner WR/W-L tradeoff. High-WR portfolios stayed around W/L 1.3, while W/L >=2.0 portfolios stayed around 36-39% WR.

h4_independent_observer_families.interpretation: A genuinely new H4/D1 premise produced the first exact-MT5 row with WR >=50% and W/L >=2.0, but the sample and active-day coverage are tiny, so it is a clue rather than a demo candidate.

d1_compression_frequency_mechanics.interpretation: Uncapping the one-position bottleneck raised the baseline from 19 to 103 closed trades and preserved WR/W-L core shape at max16, but raw signal frequency is still only 107 signals across the full window and active days are only 7.48%. This branch can only be a component clue unless a separate frequency source is found.

d1_compression_raw_frequency_ladder.interpretation: Raw-frequency broadening lifted the best broad row to 335 trades and 20.33% active weekdays, but the both-direction row missed WR by 0.45 points. Exact-ledger diagnostics showed shorts were the drag and longs preserved core shape.

h4_d1_long_only_frequency_stress.interpretation: Post-diagnostic long-only frequency stress produced the current best exact-MT5 Gold component clue: WR and W/L are comfortably above owner core, but active days remain only 19.56%, so no demo/reviewer yet.

h1_d1_long_expansion_frequency_stress.interpretation: Lowering the D1 breakout expansion decision bar from H4 to H1 broke the edge. Best H1 row had only 41 trades, WR 4.88%, W/L 2.0367, PF 0.1044. Do not continue this H1 branch.

h4_d1_long_only_robustness_audit.interpretation: Strongest exact-MT5 Gold component clue so far, but not reviewer-ready and not demo-ready.

h4_d1_long_only_pre2022_robustness.interpretation: Frozen H4 long-only 2022-2026 clue is rejected as a robust component because the older 2016-2021 exact MT5 extension fails WR and W/L core shape.

daily_extreme_reclaim_prereg_probe.interpretation: Frequency was acceptable for several M5 rows, and W/L hovered near or above 2.0, but win rate stayed around 24.7%-28.1%. The family failed the preregistered design-window core/near-frontier gate, so the 2022-2026 exam was intentionally not spent.

high_payout_feature_gate_diagnostic.interpretation: Single-feature gates on high-payout exact-MT5 portfolios did not bridge the owner tradeoff. The best usable row retained 91.71% of trades but WR was only 36.69%; aggressive rows approached 48% WR only by retaining about 10% of trades and collapsing activity. No exact-MT5 replay or reviewer spend is justified.

news_hygiene_diagnostic.interpretation: The fixed deterministic macro-event hygiene windows did not move any tested exact-MT5 Gold portfolio into the owner or replay-candidate shape. Do not spend reviewer budget or implement a news blocker from this result.

best_of_each_hybrid_frontier.interpretation: Hybrid reached WR and W/L core shape but remains short of daily activity. Reviewer may be useful only if owner accepts frequency gap.

m5_ema_htf_frequency_source.interpretation: Existing M5 EMA trend-continuation mode can create thousands of exact-MT5 trades, but at 2R the hit rate stays around 35%, so it does not solve the owner WR/W-L/activity intersection.

remaining_builtin_2r_design_exam.interpretation: A remaining built-in compression family briefly showed the 50%/2R core shape on the 2016-2021 design window, but failed the frozen 2022-2026 exact MT5 exam. No reviewer spend or demo/runtime work is justified for this branch.

hybrid_categorical_gate_diagnostic.interpretation: Simple causal categorical gates can lift the broad hybrid to the closest high-cadence frontier so far, but still miss W/L 2.0 and 90% active weekdays. This is not reviewer-worthy yet; it suggests the next exact work must improve payout without sacrificing the broad hybrid cadence.

hybrid_long_hour_payout_repair_diagnosti.interpretation: Diagnostic crossed WR and W/L with near-owner activity, but required exact MT5 replay before any review spend.

hybrid_lh3_10_13_14_exact_replay.interpretation: Exact MT5 replay preserved WR over 50% and high cadence but missed W/L 2.0 by 0.0141 and remained below 90% active weekdays. Keep as frontier context; do not spend reviewer token.

hybrid_f67_h16_exact_repair.interpretation: Rerunning the three f67 components with server hour 16 blocked improved payoff but exact composition landed just below both hard core thresholds: WR 49.96% and W/L 1.9999.

hybrid_f67_h16_no_f33_composition.interpretation: This is the strongest frontier so far: exact-ledger composition clears WR and W/L, but only by a razor-thin margin, remains below the 90% active-day threshold, and fails +0.30/ticket W/L stress. It is not demo-ready.

hybrid_companion_activity_search.interpretation: The best single exact-ledger companion filter preserves WR/W-L but only adds 7 active weekdays, leaving activity at 87.06%. No reviewer spend.

hybrid_companion_combo_search.interpretation: Small companion combos can buy activity above 90% and preserve W/L above 2.0, but WR falls to about 46.4%. The existing exact source pool does not bridge the goal.

hybrid_v7_v11_antipoison_gate_diagnostic.interpretation: Causal MT5 signal-feature gates on v7/v11 can preserve core shape only when they add almost no active days; gates that reach 90% activity still leave full-window WR around 47%.

hybrid_prune_fill_diagnostic.interpretation: Categorical pruning of the current baseline plus v7/v11 activity fill still cannot restore WR. The current family can buy 90%+ activity and W/L >2.0, but WR remains around 46-47%.

liquidity_sweep_reclaim_2r_diagnostic.conclusion: 2R-native false-break/reclaim buys activity and payoff but collapses win rate to about 30%; no exact-MT5 replay, demo spec, or reviewer spend.

htf_pullback_reclaim_2r_diagnostic.conclusion: Quality-first HTF/M5 pullback-reclaim improves structure versus raw false-break but still collapses WR to about 31-33% at 2R. No exact-MT5 replay, demo spec, or reviewer spend.
